method_note: Counted the 46 parallel technical sessions (Technical Sessions 1-4 on 27 Aug in Rooms 1-7 and Sessions 5-7 on 28 Aug in Rooms 1-6) listed in the official Program Book (IAA_SpaceAI2026_ProgramBook.pdf, linked as 'Program book Download' on the official Program page; the download link is session-tokenized). Each session weighted equally; a session is split 50/50 when it spans two keywords; mapping is based on session titles checked against the paper titles listed in each session. 171 paper slots are listed by title in those sessions; the two 'Space AI is Already Here' organized-session tracks list no papers (mapped to ai-ml only). Plenary, invited talk (Xiangyuan Zeng), panel discussion and outlook session excluded. Because the whole conference is about AI, ai-ml is used only where a session is about AI methods/assurance per se; application topics take precedence otherwise. This is consistent with news coverage (fnnews.com, 26 Aug 2026) reporting more than 170 papers. Omitted (raw share <0.02): space-comm 0.011, control-theory 0.011, stm 0.011, structures 0.011, avionics 0.011, motion-planning 0.011, planetary-defense 0.011, space-policy 0.011, hri 0.011, rovers 0.011; remaining weights renormalized to sum to 1 (retained raw share 0.891).
